column1: # analysis/naming2/wramx_calls.tsv -- the effect of a routine on the WRAM bank in force, for the backward scan of tools/apply_ram_operands.py (docs/research/naming2_ramop7.md)

# effect: `keeps` = the routine writes no bank register, or saves the hWRAMBank shadow at entry and restores both registers from it at exit: the real bank after the call is the one before it only while

#         hWRAMBank == rSVBK at entry (the shadow-desync window of docs/research/naming2_verify_ramop7.md section 4c: 5 executed call sites of the part A rows return in a bank not seen before the call);
#         `sets W7` = it is bank 7 after the call (the routine selects it and does not restore);
#         `keeps if A=0` = the same as `keeps` when A is the constant 0 at the call (the routine takes a bank in A, 0 meaning none).
# A routine that is not listed is unknown: a call to it between a bank switch and a site ends the proof.  Every row says how the effect was read.
